title: Freedom Yield Metal — A-chain Anchor History v1 (RETIRED — superseded by anchor-history.schema.v2.json)
x-retirement-note: RETIRED as the current contract by the 2026-07-01 anchor design revision (HC-single 4-action pack, 3-branch Merkle DAG). This v1 schema described the single-action fyid1:<dag_root_hash> memo shape, which was retired from the fyid1v1c* namespace after the 2026-07-01 mainnet accident (tx 997881e844befaf9c159c741988fe99e8ca566a52e539639ab83517b1f36100a). The live appender scripts/append-anchor-history.sh now REQUIRES schema_version == 2 and rejects any other value; the runtime /api/anchor-history.jsonl is a v2 ledger. This v1 document is retained (NOT deleted) purely as a reachable historical contract for any pre-2026-07-01 v1 lines and for consumers pinning the old schema hash; do NOT author new anchors against it. Forward format: /api/anchor-history.schema.v2.json. Companion design: docs/ANCHOR_SOURCE.md, project memory project_cycle3_anchor_broadcast_complete_20260704.
description: RETIRED (2026-07-01) — superseded by /api/anchor-history.schema.v2.json; see x-retirement-note above. Formal contract for the v1 shape of /api/anchor-history.jsonl. Each LINE of the JSONL file is a JSON object matching this schema; the file as a whole is an append-only, monotonically cycle_n-ordered ledger of every anchor that has reached verification_status == 'live'. Companion to /api/anchor-receipt.json (= the always-latest single record) and /api/identity.json (= the snapshot manifest pointing at this history). Role separation: anchor-receipt.json is the CURRENT anchor; anchor-history.jsonl is the FULL TIMELINE. Each history line preserves the persistent identity of an anchor (cycle_n, dag_root_hash, tx_id, explorer_url, block_num/time, signer) without the volatile pointer / regeneration metadata of the receipt. Append-only invariants are enforced by scripts/append-anchor-history.sh: tx_id duplicate rejection, cycle_n duplicate rejection, cycle_n monotonic increase, schema validation at line append time, and final-line LF guarantee. The history file is published to /api/anchor-history.jsonl ONLY AFTER the first live anchor exists — pre-deployment evidence.json marks this artifact as in_preparation. Companion design: docs/MERKLE_DAG_SPEC.md, project memory project_phase_alpha_anchor_completion_2026_07_04.

x-revision-history.summary: Initial v1 schema for the append-only anchor history ledger introduced as part of the 2026-07-04 cycle-3 anchor completion.

Per-event-type conditional required fields: idrotate entries carry key_seq (canonical reference for key-rotation events) and omit cycle_n; cyclestart/cycleend continue to carry cycle_n. Backward-compatible: existing cyclestart/cycleend entries still validate. Added key_seq property and allOf conditional. cycle_n removed from top-level required, replaced by event-type-discriminated requirement.

x-line-encoding: JSONL — UTF-8, one JSON object per line, lines terminated by LF (0x0A) including the final line, no trailing blank lines. Schema describes the per-line object shape; consumers MUST validate each line independently.
x-append-only-invariants: tx_id is unique across all lines (= duplicate rejection at append time)
For cyclestart/cycleend: (cycle_n, event_type) pair is unique across all lines (= same cycle's same event cannot be appended twice)
For idrotate: (key_seq, 'idrotate') pair is unique across all lines (= same key rotation cannot be appended twice)
cycle_n strictly non-decreasing across lines that carry cycle_n (= idrotate entries do not participate in this check)
existing lines are byte-for-byte immutable; the only legal write is appending a new line
file terminates with LF on the final line

then.description: idrotate entries MUST carry key_seq; cycle_n is OPTIONAL for idrotate (idrotate's canonical reference is the key rotation index, not the cycle index).

else.description: Non-idrotate entries (cyclestart, cycleend, manual) MUST carry cycle_n.

cycle_n.description: The validator cycle this anchor pertains to. Required for cyclestart/cycleend; OPTIONAL/OMITTED for idrotate (= idrotate is identified by key_seq, not cycle_n). Append-only invariants: among lines that carry cycle_n, the (cycle_n, event_type) pair MUST be unique, and cycle_n MUST be non-decreasing line-to-line.

key_seq.description: Operator-identity key rotation sequence number. Required for event_type=idrotate (= the canonical reference for which rotation this anchor records). Optional for other event types. Append-only invariant: for idrotate entries, (key_seq, 'idrotate') pair MUST be unique.

event_type.description: What triggered this anchor. Matches anchor-receipt's anchor.inscribe_action.data.event_type (Phase β) or trigger_event (Phase α). 'manual' is reserved for operator-initiated re-anchors outside the cycle automation; recorded for completeness but expected to be rare.

dag_root_hash.description: 64-hex SHA-256 of the DAG root at the moment of this anchor. The history line is the canonical persisted record of WHICH root was inscribed at WHICH cycle moment.

memo.description: On-chain memo carried by the inscription. MUST equal 'fyid1:' + dag_root_hash (= the memo equality invariant verified at receipt-generation time and re-asserted here).

network.description: xpr-mainnet for production history entries; xpr-testnet appears only in example/test data.

chain.description: Always 'metal-a-chain' (= the A-chain of the Metal Blockchain Primary Network).

chain_backend.description: Execution engine label, mirrors anchor-receipt.anchor.chain_backend. For metal-a-chain this is 'pulsevm'. Optional — included for completeness when present in the receipt.

method.description: Discriminator inherited from the receipt. Lets a consumer filter the history to Phase α-era or Phase β-era anchors.

tx_id.description: XPRNetwork transaction id of the inscribing tx. Append-only invariant: globally unique across the full file (= duplicate rejection at append time).

block_num.description: Block number at which the inscribing tx was included on A-chain mainnet.

block_time.description: Chain-side block time (ISO 8601). Note this is the on-chain time; verified_at below is the off-chain time at which the receipt was generated AFTER all seven PASS conditions completed.

explorer_url.description: Public XPRNetwork explorer URL pointing at this inscribing transaction. Deterministically generated from tx_id at receipt-generation time (= same tx_id always produces the same URL — see fixture #7 in the test plan).

signing_actor.description: Antelope/EOSIO account that signed the inscribing action. For production mainnet entries this is always 'metalfreedom'. Equals anchor-receipt.signing_actor at the moment the history line was appended.

signing_permission.description: Permission name used for signing. For production mainnet entries this is always 'anchor' (= the narrow linkauth-scoped child permission, see docs/MERKLE_DAG_SPEC.md §key-separation).

verification_status.description: Anchor history lines are ONLY appended for anchors that completed verification — verification_status is therefore restricted here to 'live' (= the seven PASS conditions all PASSed at receipt-generation time and again at append time) or 'failed' (= the anchor was attempted, broadcast, but did not pass within the operator's confirmation window — kept in history as a NEGATIVE auditable record). The 'scheduled' and 'broadcast' states from anchor-receipt.schema.v1.json are NOT valid here: an anchor in those states is in the receipt only, not yet in history.

verified_at.description: Off-chain timestamp at which the seven PASS conditions completed and the history line was appended. Distinct from block_time (which is the chain-side time).

generated_by_script_version.description: Optional. Identifier of the append-anchor-history.sh version that wrote this line (= git short SHA at append time). Lets a future auditor correlate behaviour with the script revision.
